package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for background_worker_started_from_http_handler_registration: Route or middleware setup that also starts unrelated background jobs.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func RegisterRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux, queue chan string) {
	workerCount := 4
	for i := 0; i < workerCount; i++ {
		go func(id int) {
			for task := range queue {
				fmt.Printf("worker %d processing: %s\n", id, task)
			}
		}(i)
	}

	go func() {
		log.Println("background metrics reporter started")
	}()

	mux.HandleFunc("/api/task", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		task := r.URL.Query().Get("name")
		queue <- task
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "task %s queued", task)
	})

	mux.HandleFunc("/api/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		fmt.Fprintln(w, "ok")
	})
}
